description: This file is a minified JavaScript module for the OrchardCore admin theme, including modal dialog handling, sidebar toggling, and other UI interactions.

methods.name: confirmDialog
methods.description: Displays a confirmation modal dialog with customizable title, message, and callback handling.

methods.name: setCompactStatus
methods.description: Sets the sidebar to a compact (collapsed) state.

methods.name: unSetCompactStatus
methods.description: Reverts the sidebar to its expanded state.

methods.name: isCompactExplicit
methods.description: Boolean flag indicating if the compact state was explicitly set.

methods.name: setCompactExplicit
methods.description: Sets the explicit compact state flag.

methods.name: getAdminPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves stored admin preferences from local storage.

methods.name: setAdminPreferences
methods.description: Stores admin preferences in local storage.
